excl.s: Big Tech earnings and Anthropic's mid-November IPO will test investor appetite for AI; Ramp data shows a record 8% of firms switched AI providers in September.
New Ramp data shows AI spend growth slowed sharply over the past two months; Ramp's economist points to falling prices for frontier models.
Total AI spend on Ramp is falling even as token volumes rise, as OpenAI and Anthropic compete on price. Top-1% spend per employee fell nearly 10% from July to August.

items.t: Oil jumps 2%, settles at 6-month highs on fears of escalation in Iran
items.s: Crude prices climbed about 2% to their highest settlement in six months as traders priced in the risk of a wider conflict involving Iran.

items.t: US SEC's top cop says agency is monitoring AI corporate disclosures
items.s: The SEC's enforcement chief said the agency is watching how companies describe their use of AI to investors, signaling scrutiny of overstated AI claims.

items.t: Bayer wins Roundup weedkiller cancer trial while awaiting settlement ruling
items.s: A jury sided with Bayer in another Roundup cancer case as the company waits for a court decision on its broader settlement plan.

items.t: Tesla and 113 other companies paid no current federal income tax
items.s: An analysis finds more than 100 profitable US corporations, including Tesla, owed no current federal income tax, raising questions about tax breaks and the deficit.

items.t: Hershey says gas-squeezed consumers are buying less candy

items.t: A Wall Street veteran argues an AI slowdown could extend the boom

items.t: Alphabet's October wipeout hits $766 billion, its worst month ever
